item.description: Today on the Happy Half Hour, Darin and Kassidy recap Saturday's home playoff game, praise Panther fans for helping create an incredible playoff environment, look back at the 2025 season, and so much more!

item.title: Sideline Pass Ep. 39
item.description: This week on Sideline Pass, Kristen and Sharon recap the Panthers playoff loss to the LA Rams, react to Dan Morgan's end-of-season-presser, share some of their favorite moments from the 2025 season, and so much more!

item.title: Happy Half Hour Episode 195: Hallowed Ground (Feat. JJ Jansen)

item.description: Today on Jordan & Jake, the guys celebrate Luke Kuechly getting inducted into the Hall of Fame, react to T-Mac being crowned the Offensive Rookie of the Year, preview Sunday's Super Bowl between Seattle and New England, and so much more!

item.description: Today on the Happy Half Hour, Darin and Kassidy react to the Seattle Seahawks defeating the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX, recap NFL Honors, celebrate Luke Kuechly making the NFL Hall of Fame, and so much more!

item.title: Anish Shroff with Hall of Fame Linebacker, Luke Kuechly
item.description: Hall of Fame linebacker, Luke Kuechly, speaks with Panthers play-by-play announcer, Anish Shroff, about his induction to the NFL Hall of Fame, how he found out, who impacted his life along the journey, being a good teammate, the importance of preparation, and so much more!
